english.meaning: the day one gets ahead; a chance to make it
english.note: 總有出頭天 means one day you will make it.

exampleSentences.english: Sometimes you’ll find it—don’t be so bleak. There’s always hope; better days will come.
exampleSentences.traditional: 揾到𠸏有時，唔好咁渺茫，唔好咁渺茫，總有希望𠸏，總有出頭天嗎。
